instruction: Clear all site data for Amazon from Chrome so they can't track my activity anymore.

metadata.explanation: Task requires clearing Amazon site data (primarily cookies). Uses existing is_cookie_deleted metric to verify .amazon.com cookies are removed.
metadata.verification: The is_cookie_deleted function checks if any cookie domain matches .amazon.com. Returns 1.0 if no Amazon cookies found, 0.0 otherwise.

llm_judge_reasons: Postconfig correctly restarts Chrome to allow reading the updated Cookies database
Getter (get_cookie_data) successfully extracts all cookies from Chrome's SQLite database
Metric (is_cookie_deleted) correctly checks for absence of .amazon.com domain cookies with proper inverted logic
Domain .amazon.com correctly matches all Amazon subdomains
Incomplete coverage: instruction says 'all site data' but evaluator only checks cookies (not cache, local storage, IndexedDB, etc.)
However, cookies are the primary tracking mechanism mentioned in the instruction ('can't track my activity')
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider adding verification for other site data types (cache, local storage, IndexedDB) if full 'site data' coverage is required
Alternatively, update instruction to be more specific: 'Clear all cookies for Amazon' instead of 'all site data'
Current approach is acceptable if cookies are considered sufficient for anti-tracking purposes
